newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia seeks to set up domestic gold market.
newsitem.headline: Russia seeks to set up domestic gold market.

text.p: Russia's central bank said on Monday that it had approved a series of measures encouraging domestic commercial banks to finance gold mining and to create a domestic gold market.

A bank news release said the new rules allowed banks to trade gold on the domestic market in a limited way through what it called special "precious metal accounts" and to make limited, gold-backed loans.
Russia has not yet passed laws creating a gold futures market but is planning to do so, the release said.
Interfax news agency said that about 100 Russian banks held licences to work with gold and eight were allowed to sell gold abroad.
The release said the central bank planned to carry out operations with gold on the domestic market to support the market's liquidity.
Russia produced about 132 tonnes of gold in 1995, but only five tonnes were financed by domestic commercial banks.
